metadata.amendment_convention: The register prints deleted text struck through inside literal double parentheses, which stay in the body around the [-...-] run, and inserted text underlined, written {+...+}. The underlined "AMENDATORY SECTION" label is typography and excluded by the inserted_selector.
metadata.authority_role: Amends WAC 388-450-0015 to add, For Basic Food only, legally obligated current or back child support paid to someone outside the assistance unit to the income "we do not count"; the Purpose statement calls this an income exclusion prior to the gross income test. Read with WSR 09-16-095 for the postponed effective date.
metadata.citation_path_note: The WSR HTML prints no register issue date, so the path's date segment is the printed filing date, unlike the publication-date segment of the Delaware and Louisiana register paths.
metadata.discovered_via: policyengine-us child support election citations and PR #9622; source retrieved directly from the official publisher
metadata.effective_date_note: The printed August 14, 2009 effective date is moved to November 15, 2009 by WSR 09-16-095, separately retained.
metadata.expression_date_note: Filing date printed in the register document header; path date is this filing date, not an inferred issue publication date.
metadata.source_authority: Washington Department of Social and Health Services, Economic Services Administration
metadata.source_bytes_note: The publisher serves a rendering last modified 2012-09-05 (HTTP Last-Modified), not a 2009 capture.
metadata.title: Washington State Register WSR 09-15-085, permanent rule amending WAC 388-450-0015
